comparison.objective: Angle a full-size click-lock vinyl tile tongue into an installed row and lower it flat to lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-edge insertion into a narrow groove while coordinating the unsupported near edge, followed by contact-driven lowering and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Tile ends flat, aligned to the row and spacer, with its long click joint fully engaged and no raised/open seam; incomplete engagement earns only partial credit.
comparison.reason: Its tested ability is long compliant-profile edge engagement and lowering, not torque-preserving screw adjustment, jam-nut locking, or retained cycle verification.
